name: Elder gives the sword
notes: The elder hands Kai the sword and explains the quest. The first time it ends, has_sword becomes 1 and a fanfare plays.

lines.speaker: ELDER
lines.text: THE WILDS ARE DANGEROUS, KAI. TAKE THIS OLD SWORD!

lines.speaker: ELDER
lines.text: PRESS B TO SWING IT. MONSTERS HAVE TAKEN THE SUN SHRINE UP NORTH.

lines.speaker: ELDER
lines.text: BRING BACK THE SUN CRYSTAL AND THE DAWN WILL RETURN!
